rules.statement: In a Court of Requests, where two or more causes of action are joined in the same plaint, it must appear that all the causes of action are consistent with each other, entitle the plaintiff to the same kind of relief, and affect all the parties.
rules.supporting_quote: "That section 805 of the Civil Procedure Code enacts that where in the same plaint two or more causes of action are joined, it must appear on the face of the plaint that all the causes of action so united are consistent with each other, that they entitled the plaintiff to the same kind of relief, and that they affect all the parties."
